applies_to: YORK by Johnson Controls YK water-cooled centrifugal chillers (OptiView panel) fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: The YK's SC-EQ card puts the chiller on a BACnet MS/TP trunk (it also speaks Modbus RTU and N2). It exposes remote run/stop and setpoint objects, temperatures and pressures, motor and drive data, and operation, fault and warning codes as MV objects with matching AV copies. Drive points depend on the starter: variable speed drive (VSD, including Raptyr), solid-state starter (SSS) or electromechanical.
notes: Points list for the SC-EQ (SC-EQUIP) communication card, which replaced the E-Link gateway. The list has no read/write column: the REM remote command/setpoint objects are treated as commandable and MV 65001 Units as writable; everything else as read-only.

Two object sets share instances by starter type: AV 13-18 and AV 121-122 change meaning with the starter: VSD values on a VSD chiller, solid-state starter (SSS) values on an SSS chiller. They are listed once here with both names.
Operating hours and kWh are also split into Low and Offset AVs: total = Offset x 10,000 + Low.
Units shown are the IP units; with MV 65001 set to SI the card reports °C, kPa and so on.

Status-code MVs (operation, fault, warning, modified run, start inhibit, internal fault) are the printed code + 1, as the doc's status code tables say; the AV copies (AV 401 and up) carry the raw code. MVs with their own enum in the points table (Units, control sources) are shown as printed, from 0; BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the card may report the printed number + 1. Confirm by discovery.
Long fault and warning code tables are summarised in the MV states; the full text is in the source document.

integration.summary: Wire the BAS to the SC-EQ J12 RS-485 port, set the MAC address on the DIP switch and let the card detect BACnet MS/TP. Write the remote run/stop, leaving chilled liquid setpoint and current limit, then read motor run status, the operation code, leaving chilled liquid temperature, % FLA and the safety fault code. Check MV 5 and MV 10-13 to confirm the chiller is taking its commands from the BAS.

minimum_points.name: UNIT CONTROL SOURCE
minimum_points.why: Control source; ISN (BAS) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 1 REM RUN STOP CMD (0 = Stop, 1 = Run) is the BAS run/stop, and the REM AVs are the remote setpoints. MV 5 Unit Control Source shows Local, ISN (BAS), Analog, Digital, Modem or Remote. MV 10 shows the run/stop source (Local, BAS, Hardwire) and MV 11-13 the cooling setpoint, heating setpoint and current limit sources (Local, BAS, 0-10 V, 4-20 mA, PWM); check they read BAS. The points list has no write-enable point and doesn't say how the source is chosen at the chiller panel.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
MV 65001 Units sets whether the BAS sees IP or SI values, independent of the chiller display; set it to match the chiller.
Turn the card's RS-485 end-of-line switches on only when it is at the end of the trunk.
gotchas: The BAS port is RS-485 only (BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2); the card has no BACnet IP port.
AV 13-18 and AV 121-122 change meaning with the starter: VSD values on a VSD chiller, solid-state starter (SSS) values on an SSS chiller.
Remote setpoints show as unreliable until the BAS has written them once.
The card only exposes points that apply to the detected chiller and its options. Replacing an E-Link leaves the old, non-applicable points offline in the BAS until you rediscover the device.
Code points come in pairs: the MV state is the code + 1, and the AV copy (AV 401 and up) carries the raw code.
